INSIDE THE MODEL

What goes into a pick

The factors, the testing, and a place to keep your ideas.

NBA + NFL

Core inputs

IN USE
  • Team strengthElo ratings update from final scores and opponent strength.
  • Home advantageAccounts for the home team; NFL neutral-site games are treated separately.
  • Team forecastThe Elo model uses past final scores and opponent strength to rank likely winners. Its probabilities have not been calibrated.
  • Available oddsShown for your own comparison. Prices do not decide which team the model predicts to win.
  • OrderingThe three strongest modeled winners each day are saved before the games. Rankings are not validated confidence.

NBA + NFL

Factors under research

PAUSED

Waiting for the latest model details.

Rest and recent scoring margin are paused while we prepare stronger tests. A new factor needs preregistration, multiple-season replication, an untouched holdout, and a comparison with the market before it can enter the model. No result guarantees profit.

ON THE RADAR

Tracked, but not model inputs

NOT IN USE
Referee assignments

NBA crews are archived when available; NFL history is researched. Assignments can change and their effects are unvalidated.

Injuries & lineups

Reported NBA and NFL positions across offense, defense and special teams are tracked; player impact and projected lineups are not yet modeled. Prices may already reflect news.

Score simulations

10,000 seeded draws of projected scores and historical score variation are saved for comparison. They do not change picks until validated against later games and market prices.
